title: Chapter 7168: Black Dragon King

Chapter 7168: Black Dragon King

Chapter 7168: Black Dragon King

“Young Noble, I’m still lost as to how to guide my race.” She bowed and asked respectfully.

“It is not any of my business.” He shook his head.

She continued to kneel while he walked deeper into a source - a place with nothing, only life force.

It appeared solidified instead of flowing freely, taking the form of a stone. The amount of life force contained within was only limited by the imagination. As long as one could imagine it, it would possess that much life force and more.

The solidified stone couldn’t be damaged or destroyed. However, there was somehow a crack on it, allowing life force to trickle out into a pond beneath.

Due to a lack of temporal affinity, one couldn’t tell how long this had been going on.

“What is this thing?” She finally looked up and stared at the stone, perplexed since it technically didn’t exist in space and time.

“Nest of Life, one of the nine maternal powers and forms.” He explained.

“This is not dao power or worldly essence, not any known force either.” She remarked.

As a primordial immortal, she could sense and derive most powers. However, the crack was the only thing allowing her to sense it. Whatever this was, it was being changed into life liquid.

This truly shocked her because at her level, she could begin learning about the high heaven’s power and laws. This Nest of Life was just something else entirely.

“Your Phoenix Queen wouldn’t have spent so much time and effort on this if it were so easy. In terms of maternal power, she had gone further than anyone.” He said.

“I see.” She realized the crack was due to Phoenix Queen.

Li Qiye turned his attention to the pond - within was a black-scaled dragon, looking immaculate like a perfect work of art.

She was in awe upon seeing it and said: “The most perfect divine beast. We only had one before in our history.”

“Skykiller True Dragon.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes.” She said before commenting: “It didn’t look like this before.”

“Your queen wanted to return it to the most perfect state, a second Skykiller.” He explained: “Unfortunately, it was impossible.”

“Why is that?” She asked.

“Because he is Black Dragon King, not Skykiller True Dragon.” He smiled.

“The bloodline is identical, this is His Majesty’s bloodline.” She said.

“By becoming Skykiller True Dragon, he would also regain his memories, Phoenix Queen included. However, all of this was thoroughly and purposefully destroyed; not even the high heaven can restore it. Thus, he will always be Black Dragon King.” He said.

“Destroyed thoroughly? And on purpose.” She was confused.

Immortals, if somehow fortunate enough to start over, always wanted previous memories. This made reaching the top again far easier.

“Love. If the past is so traumatic, it’s better not to remember.” He said.

She froze for a bit, feeling slightly suffocated. After a while, she breathed in and said: “Love.”

Finally, she bowed and asked: “Young Noble, can he stay?”

“No.” Li Qiye answered.

“Young Noble, we need him, he is our hope, perfection incarnate. If he stays, he’ll become an apex beast for certain.” She said.

“For him, your race will be an annoyance, not help.” He said.

“But our race will survive through him.” She murmured.

“Phoenix Queen had the same idea. Skykiller was just like him, how successful was it?” He asked.

This comparison killed her argument and made her shudder.
